name: After § 24
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 24 a. Regrets the scarce ambition in tackling the vulnerabilities in the Union’s value chains by reducing dependencies on critical inputs from non-EU countries, with the aim of achieving strategic autonomy in key sectors; deplores the lack of a dedicated budget line for securing critical raw materials essential to the battery industry; further advocates for increased future funding to reduce reliance on US Big Tech and to support the emergence of European Tech champions;
